name: Apache Airflow Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source workflow scheduling and monitoring platform with Python DAGs, task dependencies, scheduler, UI, executors and extensible provider integrations; no vendor-imposed self-hosted DAG-run quota.
watch_out: You operate the Airflow scheduler, API/UI, metadata database, workers and authentication; infrastructure, storage, observability and external integrations can cost money. Managed Airflow hosting such as MWAA/Composer is not included.
